# AnyAPI

AnyAPI provides a marketplace of utility APIs for validation, currency conversion, holidays, document generation, web data, and other common application workflows.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/anyapi/.

## Actions

- **Analyze Sentiment** (read-only): Classify the sentiment of English, Spanish, or Portuguese text and return the provider's label, score, language, and tokens.
- **Calculate VAT** (read-only): Calculate the tax-inclusive total and applicable VAT details for a pre-tax amount and country, optionally considering a VAT number and…
- **Check Holiday** (read-only): Return holidays AnyAPI reports for a calendar date and country.
- **Convert Currency** (read-only): Convert a monetary amount between two currency codes using the latest available exchange rate.
- **Create Google Sheet Row**: Append a row to a Google Sheets tab.
- **Delete Google Sheet Row**: Permanently delete an existing row from a Google Sheet tab by its row ID.
- **Find Phone Numbers** (read-only): Find phone numbers in text and return each number's parsed format, validity, type, and character offsets.
- **Generate Blog OpenGraph Image**: Currently unavailable because AnyAPI's Chromium runtime is failing.
- **Generate PDF Invoice**: Generate and return a downloadable PDF invoice using seller, customer, tax, payment, locale, and up to one line item.
- **Get Google Sheet Document** (read-only): Return a Google Sheets document's title, locale, and sheet-tab titles.
- **Get Google Sheet Rows** (read-only): Get the JSON payload for one Google Sheets tab as an object or array of row objects.
- **Get VAT Rates** (read-only): Return the latest applicable VAT rate and charge treatment for a country and optional VAT number.
- **List Exchange Rates** (read-only): Return the latest available exchange rates for every supported currency relative to an optional base currency, or AnyAPI's default when…
- **List Holidays** (read-only): List holidays for a country, optionally narrowed by subdivision, language, and year.
- **Lookup IP** (read-only): Look up approximate location, timezone, daylight-saving, and country-flag details for an IPv4 or IPv6 address.
- **Scrape Webpage** (read-only): Currently unavailable because AnyAPI's Chromium runtime is failing.
- **Take Website Screenshot**: Currently unavailable because AnyAPI's Chromium runtime is failing.
- **Validate Email** (read-only): Validate an email address and report syntax, typo, disposable-domain, and MX checks.
- **Validate IBAN** (read-only): Validate an IBAN and return its normalized formats plus bank and BIC details.
- **Validate Phone Number** (read-only): Validate and parse one phone number into country, type, international, national, and telephone-URI forms.
- **Validate VAT Number** (read-only): Validate a VAT number and return its normalized identifier plus country and registered-company details.
